value: Big brown bugs brew bitter bean beer.

I've spent 13 years in my hermitage. Something prevents the mist from engulfing Iluna's rock. Shipwreck after shipwreck arrives here, and the survivors cross that cursed bridge to be swallowed up. I'll stay here.

The Primes have abandoned us, but their misbegotten children still fill this miserable place. 7 Primes. Their stories wove the tapestry of our existence. They were a miserable bunch, and so it goes for the rest of us.
Dig up her bones, you'll see. The runes etched there are like tattoos, memorials for what she created. Those slobbering goblins got the same.
A faint mist escapes from your mouth as rise from the mud.
Your last memory is of a defiled bear.
As your eyes adjust, a face stares down upon you.
